description:
Update one or more clips in a single call — background, transition, duration, title, visibility, position, and (video clips) the footage transform via video_styling. Always batch.

Each entry: { clip_index, duration?, title?, background_color? | background?, transition?, hidden?, position?, voiceover_volume?, video_styling?, after_clip?, subtitle_settings? }
- duration: sets the clip's length WITHOUT rescaling anything (unlike generating speech, which rescales the whole clip). A shrink clamps every end_time past the new end to it; a grow carries an element that ended at the old end to the new end and leaves the rest where they were. A placed trim animation keeps its animation_duration: it holds its last frame on a grow and is cut on a shrink; only a stretch animation placed to fit keeps filling its window at the same speed. Keyframes keep their timestamps. Each clip's result lists what moved as extended / clamped.
- voiceover_volume: 0-100. This is how you make a clip SILENT — set 0 to mute the narration while keeping the text and its word timings. get_clip and get_project report the current value, so read it before muting to restore it later. There is no "delete voiceover" tool; muting is the supported way.
- background_color: hex (keeps the existing pattern/image, changes color). background: replaces the whole background — a full object from find(type='backgrounds'), or any image/video: { src (URL or upload id), media_type?: 'image'|'video' (inferred), color?, padding? (% around the footage, 0-100), border_radius? (px), shadow? (0-100), volume? (a video's audio, 0-100, default 100) }.
- transition: { type, duration, direction?, color?, bezier? }, or null to remove. Set on the OUTGOING clip — the transition plays at the END of clip_index, into the next clip. Types: circleWipe, rainbowWipe, cornerWipe, stack, colorWipe, dissolve, pushPull, fadeToColor, flip. Directions: rainbowWipe/cornerWipe take topLeft|topRight|bottomLeft|bottomRight; colorWipe left|right; stack/pushPull left|right|top|bottom; flip (3D card turn) horizontalLeft|horizontalCenter|horizontalRight|verticalTop|verticalCenter|verticalBottom. bezier [x1,y1,x2,y2] eases flip.
- position: move the clip to a new zero-based index. Moves apply FIRST (in array order), then property patches — keep reorders in a separate call from property edits so indices stay predictable.
- video_styling (VIDEO CLIPS ONLY — ignored on slide clips): reposition/resize the clip's recording on the canvas, e.g. into a designed window slot. { position?: [cx, cy], size?: [w, h] } as canvas fractions 0–1 ([1,1] = full-bleed, position is the footage CENTER), plus crop? and border?. Fields merge onto the clip's existing video_styling.
- after_clip (interactivity beta): where playback goes when the clip ends — { mode: 'next_clip' | 'end_video' | 'jump_clip', target_clip_id? }, or null for the default (next clip). Use it to end a branch or rejoin the main path; target_clip_id must be a visible clip_id from get_project.
- subtitle_settings: captions on this clip, { showSubtitles?, size? (px), subtitlesStyle? }. Omitted showSubtitles/size reset to true/24. subtitlesStyle is a whole SubtitlesStyle copied from a clueprint or template, never hand-written; styling (font, color, position, …) lives only inside it, and a key that can't be mapped there is dropped with a warning.
- video_styling.border frames the recording, as the editor's Stroke panel does: omnibox (browser toolbar with a URL bar over the footage — e.g. { type: "omnibox", color: "#0052CC" }), browser (window chrome), notch (phone notch), solid (plain stroke; takes stroke), glass, animated, or none. Width and color default per type like the editor; a bare { color } restyles the current border.

Concurrency: parallel-safe per clip — all property updates land in ONE save. Safe to fan out across DIFFERENT clips. Do NOT run concurrently with element/voiceover edits on the SAME clip, or whole-project mutations (add_clips, add_audio, update_project). When adding audio + resizing clips, run update_clips BEFORE add_audio.

updates.description: One entry per clip to update.

anyOf.description: Where playback goes when this clip ends. Ignored while a wait-for-click button or branch menu on the clip is unresolved — the component decides.

mode.description: next_clip (the default when unset), end_video (marks completion of a non-quiz interactive video), or jump_clip.

target_clip_id.description: jump_clip only — the clip_id to go to.

after_clip.description: Interactivity beta: where playback goes when this clip ends; null resets to next_clip.

background.description: Full background object from find(type='backgrounds'), or { src, media_type?, color?, padding?, border_radius?, shadow?, volume? } for any image/video URL or upload id.

background_color.description: Hex background color (keeps pattern, changes color)

position.description: Move clip to this zero-based index

subtitle_settings.description: Captions on this clip: {showSubtitles?, size?, subtitlesStyle?}.

bezier.description: Custom easing of the transition, CSS cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2], e.g. [0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1] for a slight bounce. Honoured by flip; omit for its default ease-in-out.

color.description: Hex color, honoured by fadeToColor (default #000000), colorWipe (default #073cad), rainbowWipe (default #D43F8C) and flip (the backdrop behind the turning card, default #000000).

direction.description: Direction, honoured only by some types: rainbowWipe and cornerWipe take topLeft/topRight/bottomLeft/bottomRight (default topRight); colorWipe takes left or right (default right); stack and pushPull take left/right/top/bottom (default right); flip takes horizontalLeft/horizontalCenter/horizontalRight/verticalTop/verticalCenter/verticalBottom (default horizontalCenter) — the axis it turns about (horizontal = left↔right, vertical = up↔down) and the line it turns on (an edge, or the middle for a card flip). Ignored by dissolve, circleWipe and fadeToColor.

type.description: Transition style. NOTE: a clip's transition plays at the END of that clip, into the next one — to put a transition between clips 2 and 3, set it on clip 2.

transition.description: Transition at the END of this clip, into the next one; null to remove

video_styling.description: VIDEO CLIPS ONLY: reposition/resize the screen recording on the canvas (e.g. into a designed window slot). position/size are canvas fractions 0–1; [1,1] = full-bleed. Fields merge onto the clip's existing video_styling. Ignored for slide clips.

border_width.description: Snake-case alias for borderWidth. Border width in pixels.

color.description: Frame color hex. Defaults per type: #212528 for omnibox/browser, #000000 for notch, #FFFFFF for glass, brand blue otherwise.

stroke.description: SOLID borders only: stroke alignment and dashed style.

type.description: Frame style. omnibox = browser toolbar with URL bar over the footage; browser = window chrome; notch = phone notch; solid = plain stroke; glass; animated; none = remove. Omit to restyle the current border.

border.description: Frame around the footage ({type?, color?, borderWidth?, stroke?} — border_width also accepted), or null to clear.

position.description: [left, top] as fractions of natural size (0–1).

size.description: [width, height] as fractions of natural size (0–1).

crop.description: Footage crop rect in fractional coords (0–1), or null to clear.

position.description: Footage center [x,y] as canvas fractions 0–1 (0.5,0.5 = centered).

voiceover_volume.description: Narration loudness for this clip, 0-100 (default 100). Set 0 for a silent cut — this MUTES the voiceover without deleting it, so the text and its word timings survive and you can restore it by setting the volume back. No-op on a clip that has no voiceover.
